Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,718 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 1.588e-05) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map.
